With a Walk Score of 94, this is the walkable Capitol Hill lifestyle you've been looking for-on a peaceful, tree-lined street in a boutique building just steps from Miller Park, light rail, shops and restaurants. And then there are the TWO private outdoorspaces-a rare find in the heart of the city. This coveted top-floor corner home offers 800 square feet and lives much larger than a typical one-bedroom, with private outdoor space to enjoy your morning coffee, garden or unwind at the end of the day. The updated kitchen feels more like something you'd expect in a single-family home, with tons of counter space, abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. The spacious primary suite features two closets and an ensuite bath with double sinks, a separate tub and shower. A full-size, side-by-side washer and dryer adds everyday convenience. Secure parking and storage, plus a pet-friendly building, make city living easy. And directly across the street, Miller Park Community Center offers an incredible array of amenities-from yoga, art and music classes to indoor/outdoor pickleball, tennis courts, sports fields, a playground with water feature, indoor gym, adult basketball and volleyball. Leave the car at home and walk to Safeway, neighborhood shops, cafes, pubs and restaurants along 15th. Light rail and transit are close by, with a bus stop just 1/2 block away. Easy access to downtown, South Lake Union, major hospitals and freeways.

text: Morning coffee on the covered balcony, evenings by the gas fireplace, and the Space Needle right outside your living room windows. This 2-bedroom, 1.75-bath corner condo at Jackson Court makes the most of its Seattle setting, with oversized windows that bring in daylight from two sides. The galley kitchen opens to the living area through a breakfast bar, a natural spot to pull up a stool and catch up while dinner's on.
